conbody.p: The drive station causes the conveyor belt to move via the drive pulley (1). A drive unit (2) is connected to the metering conveyor scale via the drive shaft (3) and is thus able to transfer its rotary movement to the metering conveyor scale. The drive unit can be optionally equipped with an anti-reversing mechanism that prevents the drive unit or conveyor belt from running backwards. The drive shaft is mounted on two pedestal bearings (4) in such a way that it can rotate. A scraper (5) cleans material contaminations from the drive pulley in order to prevent any damage to the conveyor belt.
